notes.title: 1.0.9 Update
notes.content:
Hey all, pushing out a big patch, fixes are as follows:

-Fixed Shackles not unlocking properly
-Fixed Achievements not unlocking properly
-Fixed Flamethrower and Beamgun not working while some shackles are enabled
-Fixed a few misc UI elements in the Setup Screen
-Fixed a few Shackles not working properly

ALSO

Arsenal Demon is now available on Mac and Linux!

More fixes coming soon!
